"""G4, held-out efficacy (spec §5.11, §5.12; invariant I5).

The sealed holdout is decrypted **here and only here** (the identity is passed into this
function by the Auditor's G4 activity and never stored), every holdout task runs at the base
commit and at the candidate for each seed, and the pairs (task × seed) are compared:

- exact one-sided McNemar on the discordant pairs (b: fail→pass, c: pass→fail), p < α;
- cost per task: the one-sided 95% bootstrap upper bound of the relative change < +5%;
- p95 latency: the same bound on the relative change of the 95th percentile < +10%.

Only aggregates leave: pair counts, b, c, p, pass rates with Wilson intervals and the two
bounds. Task ids, inputs and outputs never do, and the result is checked for the holdout's
canary before it is returned (an I5 leak fails the gate loudly instead of shipping).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.gates import holdout as custody
from kintsugi.gates.common import GateResult, failed, passed
from kintsugi.gates.evals import EvalResult, TaskRun, run_tasks
from kintsugi.gates.target import Target
from kintsugi.sandbox import chaos_proxy as chaos
from kintsugi.stats.bootstrap import COST_MARGIN, P95_MARGIN, relative_delta
from kintsugi.stats.mcnemar import mcnemar
from kintsugi.stats.wilson import wilson_interval

ALPHA = 0.05


class HoldoutLeak(RuntimeError):
    """Holdout content reached a G4 output: the gate refuses to return it (I5)."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Efficacy:
    n_pairs: int
    b: int
    c: int
    p: float
    pass_before: float
    pass_after: float
    ci_before: tuple[float, float]
    ci_after: tuple[float, float]
    cost_before: float
    cost_after: float
    cost_delta: float | None
    cost_ub: float | None
    p95_before: float
    p95_after: float
    p95_delta: float
    p95_ub: float
    seeds: tuple[int, ...]

    def aggregate(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """The only form G4 results leave the gate in (Surgeons see Δpass, CI and cost Δ)."""
        def r(x: float | None) -> float | None:
            return None if x is None else round(x, 6)

        return {"n_pairs": self.n_pairs, "b": self.b, "c": self.c, "p": self.p,
                "pass_before": r(self.pass_before), "pass_after": r(self.pass_after),
                "delta_pass": r(self.pass_after - self.pass_before),
                "ci_before": [r(x) for x in self.ci_before],
                "ci_after": [r(x) for x in self.ci_after],
                "cost_before": r(self.cost_before), "cost_after": r(self.cost_after),
                "cost_delta": r(self.cost_delta), "cost_ub": r(self.cost_ub),
                "p95_before": r(self.p95_before), "p95_after": r(self.p95_after),
                "p95_delta": r(self.p95_delta), "p95_ub": r(self.p95_ub),
                "seeds": list(self.seeds)}  # fmt: skip


def efficacy(before: Sequence[TaskRun], after: Sequence[TaskRun], seed: int = 0) -> Efficacy:
    """Paired statistics over runs matched by (task, seed)."""
    a_index = {(run.task, run.seed): run for run in after}
    pairs = [(run, a_index[(run.task, run.seed)]) for run in before
             if (run.task, run.seed) in a_index]  # fmt: skip
    if not pairs:
        raise ValueError("no paired runs")
    pb = [b.passed for b, _ in pairs]
    pa = [a.passed for _, a in pairs]
    test = mcnemar(pb, pa)
    n = len(pairs)
    cost_b, cost_a = [b.cost_usd for b, _ in pairs], [a.cost_usd for _, a in pairs]
    lat_b, lat_a = [b.latency_s for b, _ in pairs], [a.latency_s for _, a in pairs]
    cost = (relative_delta(cost_b, cost_a, statistic="mean", seed=seed)
            if sum(cost_b) > 0 else None)  # fmt: skip
    p95 = relative_delta(lat_b, lat_a, statistic="p95", seed=seed)
    import numpy as np

    return Efficacy(
        n_pairs=n, b=test.b, c=test.c, p=test.p,
        pass_before=sum(pb) / n, pass_after=sum(pa) / n,
        ci_before=wilson_interval(sum(pb), n), ci_after=wilson_interval(sum(pa), n),
        cost_before=float(np.mean(cost_b)), cost_after=float(np.mean(cost_a)),
        cost_delta=cost.point if cost else None, cost_ub=cost.upper if cost else None,
        p95_before=float(np.percentile(lat_b, 95)), p95_after=float(np.percentile(lat_a, 95)),
        p95_delta=p95.point, p95_ub=p95.upper,
        seeds=tuple(sorted({b.seed for b, _ in pairs})),
    )  # fmt: skip


def verdict(stats: Efficacy, *, alpha: float = ALPHA) -> GateResult:
    reasons = []
    if not stats.p < alpha:
        reasons.append(f"McNemar p = {stats.p:.3g} (needs < {alpha})")
    if stats.cost_ub is not None and not stats.cost_ub < COST_MARGIN:
        reasons.append(f"cost Δ upper bound {stats.cost_ub:+.1%} (needs < +{COST_MARGIN:.0%})")
    if not stats.p95_ub < P95_MARGIN:
        reasons.append(f"p95 Δ upper bound {stats.p95_ub:+.1%} (needs < +{P95_MARGIN:.0%})")
    evidence = stats.aggregate()
    if reasons:
        return failed("G4", "; ".join(reasons), **evidence)
    return passed("G4", f"b={stats.b}, c={stats.c}, p={stats.p:.3g}; bounds hold", **evidence)


def check_no_leak(result: GateResult, canary: str, task_ids: Sequence[str]) -> GateResult:
    blob = json.dumps(result.as_dict())
    if custody.canary_hits(blob.encode("utf-8"), canary) or any(t in blob for t in task_ids):
        raise HoldoutLeak("a G4 result contains holdout content")
    return result


Runner = Callable[[Path, list[dict[str, Any]], int], EvalResult]


def held_out_efficacy(
    target: Target,
    base_checkout: Path,
    head_checkout: Path,
    identity: str,
    *,
    seeds: Sequence[int],
    profile: chaos.Profile | None = None,
    base_cache: dict[tuple[str, int], EvalResult] | None = None,
    base_key: str = "",
) -> GateResult:
    if target.holdout is None:
        return failed("G4", f"{target.id} declares no sealed holdout")
    payload = custody.open_holdout(target.repo / target.holdout, identity)
    tasks: list[dict[str, Any]] = list(payload["tasks"])
    task_ids = [str(task["id"]) for task in tasks]
    before: list[TaskRun] = []
    after: list[TaskRun] = []
    for seed in seeds:
        cached = base_cache.get((base_key, seed)) if base_cache is not None else None
        base = cached or run_tasks(target, base_checkout, tasks, seed=seed, split="holdout",
                                   profile=profile, phase="g4-before")  # fmt: skip
        if base_cache is not None:
            base_cache[(base_key, seed)] = base
        head = run_tasks(target, head_checkout, tasks, seed=seed, split="holdout",
                         profile=profile, phase="g4-after")  # fmt: skip
        before += base.runs
        after += head.runs
    result = verdict(efficacy(before, after))
    return check_no_leak(result, str(payload["canary"]), task_ids)

"""Anti-gaming checks on a candidate's diff (spec §5.11), run by the Auditor before any gate.

1. **Protected paths**, the Auditor's half of "enforced twice" (the other half is the worktree
   pre-commit hook, ``kintsugi.gates.precommit``): tests, evals, graders, holdouts, CI and agent
   configuration (``.kintsugi/protected_paths.yaml``, scope ``surgeon``).
2. **Diff budget**: at most 120 changed lines unless the Coordinator approved more for this card
   (the approval is recorded on the card).
3. **No new outbound network calls**: added lines are scanned for HTTP clients, sockets and URL
   literals, and ``entire graph diff`` is consulted for new ``HTTP_CALLS`` relations when the
   graph is available. A fix must never reach the world the gates replay.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections.abc import Iterable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.gates.checkout import changed_files, changed_lines, diff_text
from kintsugi.gates.common import GateResult, failed, passed
from kintsugi.gates.protected_paths import Policy, load_policy

NETWORK_PATTERNS: tuple[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str]], ...] = tuple(
    (name, re.compile(pattern))
    for name, pattern in (
        ("http client import", r"^\s*(import|from)\s+(requests|httpx|aiohttp|urllib3|websockets)\b"),
        ("stdlib networking import",
         r"^\s*(import|from)\s+(socket|http\.client|urllib\.request|ftplib|smtplib)\b"),
        ("http client call",
         r"\b(requests|httpx|aiohttp)\.(get|post|put|patch|delete|head|request|Client|"
         r"AsyncClient|Session|ClientSession)\b"),
        ("socket use", r"\bsocket\.(socket|create_connection)\b"),
        ("urlopen", r"\burlopen\("),
        ("url literal", r"[\"']https?://"),
    )
)  # fmt: skip


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DiffCheck:
    result: GateResult
    paths: tuple[str, ...]
    lines: int
    network: tuple[str, ...] = field(default=())


def added_lines(diff: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """``(path, line)`` for every added line of a unified diff."""
    path, out = "", []
    for line in diff.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("+++ "):
            path = line[6:] if line.startswith("+++ b/") else line[4:]
        elif line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++"):
            out.append((path, line[1:]))
    return out


def network_findings(diff: str, graph_diff: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> list[str]:
    found = []
    for path, line in added_lines(diff):
        if not path.endswith(".py"):
            continue
        for name, pattern in NETWORK_PATTERNS:
            if pattern.search(line):
                found.append(f"{path}: {name}: {line.strip()[:120]}")
                break
    for entry in (graph_diff or {}).get("files") or []:
        for change in entry.get("changes") or []:
            if "HTTP_CALLS" in str(change.get("relations") or change.get("type") or ""):
                found.append(f"{entry.get('path')}: graph: new HTTP_CALLS from {change.get('name')}")
    return found


def check(
    repo: Path,
    base: str,
    head: str,
    *,
    policy: Policy | None = None,
    scopes: Iterable[str] = ("surgeon",),
    approved_large_diff: bool = False,
    graph_diff: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> DiffCheck:
    rules = policy or load_policy()
    paths = changed_files(repo, base, head)
    lines = changed_lines(repo, base, head)
    problems: list[str] = []
    violations = rules.violations(paths, list(scopes))
    if violations:
        problems.append("protected paths: " + ", ".join(f"{v.path} ({v.pattern})"
                                                        for v in violations))  # fmt: skip
    if rules.over_budget(lines) and not approved_large_diff:
        problems.append(f"diff of {lines} lines exceeds the {rules.diff_budget_lines}-line budget")
    network = network_findings(diff_text(repo, base, head), graph_diff)
    if network:
        problems.append("new outbound network calls: " + "; ".join(network[:5]))
    evidence = {"paths": paths, "lines": lines, "approved_large_diff": approved_large_diff}
    result = (failed("diff", "; ".join(problems), **evidence) if problems
              else passed("diff", f"{len(paths)} files, {lines} lines, no protected paths",
                          **evidence))  # fmt: skip
    return DiffCheck(result, tuple(paths), lines, tuple(network))

"""The protected-path pre-commit hook (spec §5.11: "enforced twice", the worktree half).

``install(repo)`` writes ``pre-commit`` into the repository's common hooks directory, so it runs
in every linked worktree (spike N4: worktrees share the common hooks Entire installed into). It
guards only Surgeon branches (``kintsugi/<INC>/<H>``): any staged path matching Omega's
protected-path policy (scope ``surgeon``) aborts the commit. The policy is Omega's own file,
never the target repository's copy, so a branch cannot loosen the rule it is judged by. An
existing ``pre-commit`` is kept as ``pre-commit.local`` and chained.

The Auditor re-checks the same policy on the committed diff (``kintsugi.gates.antigaming``), so
a commit that bypassed this hook (``--no-verify``) still fails its gates.

    python -m kintsugi.gates.precommit install --repo <path>
    python -m kintsugi.gates.precommit check            # what the hook runs
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path

from kintsugi.gates.protected_paths import load_policy
from kintsugi.sandbox import proc

MARKER = "# kintsugi-omega protected-path guard"
GUARDED_PREFIX = "kintsugi/"
CHAINED = "pre-commit.local"


def _git(cwd: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    return proc.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), *args], timeout_s=60, check=True).stdout.strip()


def hooks_dir(repo: Path) -> Path:
    configured = proc.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "config", "--get", "core.hooksPath"],
                          timeout_s=30).stdout.strip()  # fmt: skip
    if configured:
        path = Path(configured)
        return path if path.is_absolute() else Path(repo) / path
    common = Path(_git(repo, "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"))
    return (common if common.is_absolute() else Path(repo) / common) / "hooks"


def script(python: str) -> str:
    return (f"#!/bin/sh\n{MARKER}\n"
            f'"{Path(python).as_posix()}" -m kintsugi.gates.precommit check || exit 1\n'
            f'if [ -x "$(dirname "$0")/{CHAINED}" ]; then exec "$(dirname "$0")/{CHAINED}" "$@"; fi\n'
            "exit 0\n")  # fmt: skip


def install(repo: Path, *, python: str = sys.executable) -> Path:
    folder = hooks_dir(Path(repo))
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    hook = folder / "pre-commit"
    if hook.exists() and MARKER not in hook.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        hook.replace(folder / CHAINED)
    hook.write_text(script(python), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    hook.chmod(0o755)
    return hook


def installed(repo: Path) -> bool:
    hook = hooks_dir(Path(repo)) / "pre-commit"
    return hook.is_file() and MARKER in hook.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def check(cwd: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Problems with the staged change in ``cwd`` (empty: the commit may proceed)."""
    branch = proc.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "symbolic-ref", "-q", "--short", "HEAD"],
                      timeout_s=30).stdout.strip()  # fmt: skip
    if not branch.startswith(GUARDED_PREFIX):
        return []
    staged = [p for p in _git(cwd, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z").split("\0") if p]
    violations = load_policy().violations(staged, ["surgeon"])
    return [f"{v.path} matches protected pattern {v.pattern}" for v in violations]


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Omega's protected-path pre-commit guard.")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("check")
    inst = sub.add_parser("install")
    inst.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, default=Path("."))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "install":
        print(f"installed {install(args.repo)}")
        return 0
    problems = check(Path.cwd())
    for problem in problems:
        print(f"kintsugi pre-commit: refused: {problem}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1 if problems else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Task generator: documents of 3 to 6 lines in five currencies, with their gold bookings.

The train split is generated from a public seed; the holdout is generated once from a secret
seed by KINTSUGI-Omega's holdout custody and sealed (``generate("holdout", seed, n, canary=…)``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import random
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
from typing import Any

from practice_ledger.services.fx_api import rate

SIZES = {"train": 60, "holdout": 40}
TRAIN_SEED = 20261011
CURRENCIES = ("EUR", "GBP", "JPY", "INR", "CAD")
ACCOUNTS = ("6100-cloud", "6200-software", "6300-travel", "6400-freight", "1400-input-tax")
CENT = Decimal("0.01")


def _document(rng: random.Random, ref: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    currency = rng.choice(CURRENCIES)
    date = f"2026-{rng.randint(7, 9):02d}-{rng.randint(1, 28):02d}"
    scale = 100 if currency == "JPY" else (80 if currency == "INR" else 1)
    items = [{"account": rng.choice(ACCOUNTS),
              "amount": str(Decimal(rng.randint(500, 90000) * scale) / 100)}
             for _ in range(rng.randint(3, 6))]  # fmt: skip
    return {"ref": ref, "currency": currency, "date": date, "items": items}


def gold(document: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    fx = rate(document["currency"], document["date"])
    out = []
    for n, item in enumerate(document["items"], 1):
        usd = (Decimal(item["amount"]) * fx).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        out.append({"key": f"{document['ref']}#{n}", "account": item["account"],
                    "amount_cents": int(usd * 100), "date": document["date"]})  # fmt: skip
    return out


def generate(split: str, seed: int, n: int, *, canary: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rng = random.Random(f"{split}:{seed}")
    prefix = "TR" if split == "train" else "HO"
    tasks = []
    for i in range(n):
        document = _document(rng, f"{prefix}-{i + 1:03d}")
        task: dict[str, Any] = {"id": document["ref"], "document": document,
                                "gold": {"lines": gold(document)}}  # fmt: skip
        if canary is not None:
            task["document"]["memo"] = f"ref {canary}"
        tasks.append(task)
    return tasks


def tasks(split: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if split != "train":
        raise ValueError("only the train split is public; the holdout is sealed")
    return generate("train", TRAIN_SEED, SIZES["train"])

"""The Ledger practice repository: a disposable fixture target for gate, crew and rehearsal tests.

``make_repo`` copies ``tests/fixtures/rehearsal/ledger_practice`` into a scratch git repository
(healthy commit, then a sealed holdout under a throwaway age identity). ``plant_refactor`` makes
the disclosed practice regression: the "readability" refactor of ``reconcile`` that constructs
the posting session inside the retried closure. ``hoist_fix`` and ``lookup_fix`` are two repairs
the gates must tell apart.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from kintsugi.gates import holdout
from kintsugi.gates.target import Target, load_target
from kintsugi.proof.sealed import new_identity
from kintsugi.sandbox import proc

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FIXTURE = REPO / "tests" / "fixtures" / "rehearsal" / "ledger_practice"
REFACTOR = REPO / "tests" / "fixtures" / "rehearsal" / "refactor" / "reconcile.py"
HOST = "ledger-practice"
RECONCILE = "practice_ledger/reconcile.py"
IDENTITY = ("-c", "user.name=Surya Prasanth R", "-c", "user.email=suryaprasanthcse@gmail.com")


def git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    return proc.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], timeout_s=120, check=True).stdout.strip()


def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, *IDENTITY, "commit", "-q", "--no-verify", "-m", message)
    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Practice:
    repo: Path
    healthy: str
    identity: str  # the throwaway holdout identity (never a real key)

    @property
    def target(self) -> Target:
        return load_target(self.repo, HOST)


def make_repo(destination: Path) -> Practice:
    shutil.copytree(FIXTURE, destination, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
    git(destination, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
    git(destination, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
    commit_all(destination, "practice: the healthy ledger")
    secret, recipient = new_identity()
    target = load_target(destination, HOST)
    target.make_importable()
    holdout.seal(destination, HOST, "practice_ledger", destination, recipient=recipient)
    healthy = commit_all(destination, "practice: seal the holdout")
    return Practice(destination, healthy, secret)


def write(repo: Path, relative: str, text: str) -> None:
    (repo / relative).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def plant_refactor(repo: Path) -> str:
    write(repo, RECONCILE, REFACTOR.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return commit_all(repo, "refactor(reconcile): name the retried pass and document it")


HOISTED = (
    '    """Book every pending line of ``batch`` in USD; a rate limit retries the whole pass."""\n'
    "    current = session or PostingSession(batch)  # outside the retried scope\n\n"
    "    def book_pending_lines() -> PostingSession:\n"
)
NESTED = (
    '    """Book every pending line of ``batch`` in USD; a rate limit retries the whole pass."""\n\n'
    "    def book_pending_lines() -> PostingSession:\n"
    "        current = session or PostingSession(batch)\n"
)


def hoist_fix(repo: Path) -> str:
    text = (repo / RECONCILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    write(repo, RECONCILE, text.replace(NESTED, HOISTED))
    return commit_all(repo, "fix: construct the posting session outside the retried pass")


LOOKUP = (
    "    def book(self, line: Line, rate: Decimal) -> None:\n"
    "        if line.key not in self.booked and not already_booked(line.key):\n"
)


def lookup_fix(repo: Path) -> str:
    """Idempotency by asking the books API before every line: correct, but slower and costlier."""
    text = (repo / RECONCILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    text = text.replace(
        "    def book(self, line: Line, rate: Decimal) -> None:\n"
        "        if line.key not in self.booked:\n",
        LOOKUP,
    )
    text = text.replace("from practice_ledger.tools import fx_rate, post_line",
                        "from practice_ledger.tools import already_booked, fx_rate, post_line")
    write(repo, RECONCILE, text)
    tools = (repo / "practice_ledger/tools.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    tools += (
        "\n\n@span(kind=\"TOOL\", name=\"already_booked\")\n"
        "def already_booked(key: str) -> bool:\n"
        "    response = external.call(\"books\", \"GET\", f\"/lines/{key}\")\n"
        "    return response.status_code == 200\n"
    )
    write(repo, "practice_ledger/tools.py", tools)
    return commit_all(repo, "fix: check the books before booking a line")

"""Gates G0–G6, clean checkouts, anti-gaming checks and the pre-commit hook (spec §5.11), on
the Ledger practice repository with its disclosed practice regression."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from kintsugi.crew.casefile import CaseFile
from kintsugi.crew.llm import ScriptedModel
from kintsugi.gates import antigaming, g0, g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, precommit
from kintsugi.gates.checkout import (
    MergeConflict,
    changed_files,
    clean_checkout,
    diff_text,
    merged_checkout,
)
from kintsugi.gates.evals import run_tasks
from kintsugi.memory.entire import EntireError
from kintsugi.sandbox import proc
from tests.helpers import practice as pr


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def repo(tmp_path_factory: pytest.TempPathFactory) -> dict[str, str | Path]:
    p = pr.make_repo(tmp_path_factory.mktemp("practice") / "repo")
    buggy = pr.plant_refactor(p.repo)
    pr.git(p.repo, "branch", "buggy", buggy)
    fixed = pr.hoist_fix(p.repo)
    pr.git(p.repo, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "lookup", buggy)
    lookup = pr.lookup_fix(p.repo)
    pr.git(p.repo, "checkout", "-q", "main")
    return {"repo": p.repo, "healthy": p.healthy, "buggy": buggy, "fixed": fixed,
            "lookup": lookup, "identity": p.identity}  # fmt: skip


def _target(repo: dict[str, str | Path]):  # noqa: ANN202
    return pr.load_target(Path(repo["repo"]), pr.HOST)


def test_g0_reproduces_the_regression_and_g2_accepts_only_the_fix(repo) -> None:
    root, target = Path(repo["repo"]), _target(repo)
    tasks = target.host  # keeps pyright happy about the import below
    from practice_ledger.evals.generate import tasks as train_tasks  # type: ignore[import-not-found]

    train = train_tasks("train")
    with clean_checkout(root, str(repo["buggy"])) as buggy:
        live = run_tasks(target, buggy, train, seed=1)
        failing = live.failed()
        assert failing, "the practice regression should fail some train tasks at seed 1"
        assert {live.verdicts()[t] for t in failing} == {"FAIL:DUPLICATE_ENTRY"}
        chosen = [t for t in train if t["id"] in failing[:3]]
        repro = g0.reproduce(target, buggy, chosen, seed=1, split="train")
        assert repro.ok, repro.result.summary
        assert repro.result.evidence["replays_failing"] == 3
        assert repro.cassette is not None
        still = g2.reproduction_fixed(target, buggy, repro.cassette, chosen, repro.failing,
                                      seed=1, split="train")  # fmt: skip
        assert not still.passed
    with clean_checkout(root, str(repo["fixed"])) as fixed:
        result = g2.reproduction_fixed(target, fixed, repro.cassette, chosen, repro.failing,
                                       seed=1, split="train")  # fmt: skip
        assert result.passed, result.summary
    with clean_checkout(root, str(repo["healthy"])) as healthy:
        assert not g0.reproduce(target, healthy, chosen, seed=1, split="train").ok
    assert tasks.id == "ledger-practice"


def test_g4_accepts_the_hoist_and_rejects_the_costly_lookup(repo) -> None:
    root, target = Path(repo["repo"]), _target(repo)
    identity = str(repo["identity"])
    with (clean_checkout(root, str(repo["buggy"])) as base,
          clean_checkout(root, str(repo["fixed"])) as fixed,
          clean_checkout(root, str(repo["lookup"])) as lookup):  # fmt: skip
        good = g4.held_out_efficacy(target, base, fixed, identity, seeds=[1, 2, 3])
        costly = g4.held_out_efficacy(target, base, lookup, identity, seeds=[1, 2, 3])
    assert good.passed, good.summary
    assert good.evidence["b"] > 5 >= good.evidence["c"]
    assert good.evidence["p"] < 0.05
    assert not costly.passed
    assert "cost" in costly.summary
    blob = json.dumps([good.as_dict(), costly.as_dict()])
    assert "HO-0" not in blob  # aggregates only: no holdout task id leaves G4 (I5)
    with pytest.raises(g4.HoldoutLeak):
        g4.check_no_leak(g4.failed("G4", "HO-001 leaked"), "canary-words", ["HO-001"])


def test_g1_runs_lint_and_typecheck(repo) -> None:
    root, target = Path(repo["repo"]), _target(repo)
    with clean_checkout(root, str(repo["fixed"])) as fixed:
        assert g1.build_static(target, fixed).passed
        (fixed / "practice_ledger" / "broken.py").write_text("import os\nx: int = 'a'\n",
                                                             encoding="utf-8")  # fmt: skip
        result = g1.build_static(target, fixed)
    assert not result.passed
    assert "ruff" in result.summary


def test_g3_parses_verify_and_flags_flips_without_entire(repo) -> None:
    text = ("NEWLY FAILING (2): tests/a.py::t1, tests/a.py::t2\n"
            "VERDICT: REGRESSION in 2 tests: tests/a.py::t1, tests/a.py::t2\n")  # fmt: skip
    assert g3.parse_verify(text) == (["tests/a.py::t1", "tests/a.py::t2"], [],
                                     "REGRESSION in 2 tests: tests/a.py::t1, tests/a.py::t2")
    root, target = Path(repo["repo"]), _target(repo)
    with clean_checkout(root, str(repo["buggy"])) as base:
        before = g3.pytest_results(target, base)
        assert before and all(outcome == "PASSED" for outcome in before.values())
        reconcile = base / "practice_ledger" / "reconcile.py"
        reconcile.write_text(reconcile.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace(
            "self.cursor += 1", "self.cursor += 2"), encoding="utf-8")  # fmt: skip
        after = g3.pytest_results(target, base)
    flips = g3.pytest_flips(before, after)
    assert not flips.passed
    assert "tests/test_reconcile.py::test_resume_after_partial_batch" in flips.evidence["flips"]


@pytest.mark.contract
def test_g3_with_entire_graph_verify(repo, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root, target = Path(repo["repo"]), _target(repo)
    baseline = tmp_path / "baseline.json"
    with clean_checkout(root, str(repo["buggy"])) as base:
        g3.record_baseline(target, base, baseline)
    with clean_checkout(root, str(repo["fixed"])) as fixed:
        assert g3.no_collateral(target, fixed, baseline).passed
        reconcile = fixed / "practice_ledger" / "reconcile.py"
        reconcile.write_text(reconcile.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace(
            "self.cursor += 1", "self.cursor += 2"), encoding="utf-8")  # fmt: skip
        flipped = g3.no_collateral(target, fixed, baseline)
    assert not flipped.passed
    assert any("test_resume_after_partial_batch" in t for t in flipped.evidence["flips"])


def test_g5_ranks_down_a_revert_and_discards_invented_quotes(repo, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = Path(repo["repo"])
    originating = diff_text(root, str(repo["healthy"]), str(repo["buggy"]))
    revert = diff_text(root, str(repo["buggy"]), str(repo["healthy"]))
    hoist = diff_text(root, str(repo["buggy"]), str(repo["fixed"]))
    assert g5.revert_share(revert, originating) == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert g5.revert_share(hoist, originating) < g5.REVERT_SHARE
    record = {"stated_goal": "readability",
              "behavioral_contract": [{"clause": "no behavior change",
                                       "quote": "keep behavior identical"}]}  # fmt: skip
    case = CaseFile(tmp_path, "INC-G5")
    offline = g5.judge(None, case, hypothesis="H1", title="revert", record=record,
                       patch=revert, originating=originating)  # fmt: skip
    assert offline.status == "warn"
    model = ScriptedModel({"auditor_g5": {"judgements": [
        {"clause": "no behavior change", "quote": "keep behavior identical",
         "verdict": "kept", "reason": "hoist keeps behavior"},
        {"clause": "invented", "quote": "words nobody wrote", "verdict": "violated",
         "reason": "made up"}]}})  # fmt: skip
    judged = g5.judge(model, case, hypothesis="H2", title="hoist", record=record, patch=hoist,
                      originating=originating)  # fmt: skip
    assert judged.status == "pass"
    assert judged.evidence["discarded"][0]["quote"] == "words nobody wrote"
    calls = case.calls()
    assert all("surgeon" not in item["source"] for c in calls
               for item in c["manifest"]["included"])  # fmt: skip
    assert g5.decide({"judgements": [{"clause": "no behavior change",
                                      "quote": "keep behavior identical",
                                      "verdict": "violated", "reason": "x"}]},
                     record, provider="t").status == "fail"  # fmt: skip


def test_g6_compares_spend_with_the_budget() -> None:
    assert g6.within_budget(4.0, 12.4).passed
    assert not g6.within_budget(12.5, 12.4).passed


def test_antigaming_blocks_protected_paths_big_diffs_and_network(repo, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = Path(repo["repo"])
    clean = antigaming.check(root, str(repo["buggy"]), str(repo["fixed"]))
    assert clean.result.passed, clean.result.summary
    pr.git(root, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "gaming", str(repo["buggy"]))
    try:
        test = root / "tests" / "test_reconcile.py"
        test.write_text(test.read_text(encoding="utf-8") + "\n# weakened\n", encoding="utf-8")

        large = pr.commit_all(root, "a large change")

        net = root / "practice_ledger" / "net.py"

                       encoding="utf-8")  # fmt: skip

        found = antigaming.check(root, large, networked)
        assert "network" in found.result.summary
        assert len(found.network) == 2
    finally:
        pr.git(root, "checkout", "-q", "main")


def test_the_precommit_hook_refuses_protected_paths_on_surgeon_branches(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo = tmp_path / "hooked"
    shutil.copytree(pr.FIXTURE, repo, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
    pr.git(repo, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
    pr.commit_all(repo, "init")
    hooks = precommit.hooks_dir(repo)
    hooks.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (hooks / "pre-commit").write_text("#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    assert precommit.install(repo).name == "pre-commit"
    assert precommit.installed(repo)
    assert (hooks / precommit.CHAINED).is_file()  # an existing hook is kept and chained
    wt = tmp_path / "wt-H1"
    pr.git(repo, "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "kintsugi/INC-0001/H1", str(wt))
    test = wt / "tests" / "test_reconcile.py"

    pr.git(repo, "add", "-A")
    assert proc.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *pr.IDENTITY, "commit", "-q", "-m", "main"],
                    timeout_s=120).ok  # fmt: skip


def test_checkouts_are_clean_and_merges_report_conflicts(repo) -> None:

"""The Pathologist: confirm, cluster, describe and reproduce (spec §5.7, §6.2 step 7).

``triage`` turns an alert into a :class:`~kintsugi.control.contracts.Signature`: every failing
trace becomes an observation, observations cluster by the deterministic signature φ, and the
dominant cluster names the incident. ``claude-opus-5-5`` labels it and writes the symptom
summary (≤ 800 characters) from the five most representative traces and the cluster statistics
only. The Pathologist never reads source code, so the symptom is not anchored on a guess.

``reproduce`` is gate G0: the dominant cluster's failing tasks are re-run at their own seed on
the incident's base commit, recording the cassette that must fail 3/3 when replayed. If they do
not reproduce, the task set is widened ×3 once; still nothing means PARK (§5.11).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control.activities import InvalidAlert
from kintsugi.crew.consult import consult
from kintsugi.crew.context import CrewContext
from kintsugi.crew.manifest import ContextBuilder
from kintsugi.gates import g0
from kintsugi.gates.checkout import clean_checkout, rev
from kintsugi.sandbox import chaos_proxy as chaos
from kintsugi.senses.signature import FailureObservation, cluster, representatives

SCHEMA: Mapping[str, Any] = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
        "label": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 80},
        "summary": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 800},
    },
    "required": ["label", "summary"],
    "additionalProperties": False,
}
REPRO_TASKS = 3


def _describe(obs: FailureObservation) -> str:
    gram = " -> ".join(obs.preceding) or "(no tool calls)"
    return (f"- trace {obs.trace_id}: {obs.verdict or obs.error} after [{gram}] "
            f"(failing span {obs.failing_kind} {obs.failing_name}, tool {obs.tool_name})")  # fmt: skip


def deterministic_summary(host: str, groups: list, dominant: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
    fields = dominant.fields
    gram = " -> ".join(fields["preceding"]) or "no tool calls"
    share = f"{dominant.size}/{sum(g.size for g in groups)}"
    summary = (f"On {host}, {share} failing traces end in {fields['error_class']} on "
               f"{fields['failing_span'][1]} after the tool sequence [{gram}]; the last tool "
               f"called is {fields['tool'] or 'none'}.")  # fmt: skip
    return {"label": f"{fields['error_class']} after {gram}"[:80], "summary": summary[:800]}


class Pathologist:
    def __init__(self, ctx: CrewContext) -> None:
        if ctx.traces is None:
            raise ValueError("the Pathologist needs a trace source")
        self.ctx = ctx

    def triage(self, alert: c.Alert) -> c.Signature:
        observations = self.ctx.traces.observations(alert) if self.ctx.traces else []
        if not observations:
            raise InvalidAlert(f"{alert.incident_id}: no failing trace behind the alert")
        groups = cluster(observations)
        dominant = groups[0]
        case = self.ctx.case(alert.incident_id)
        case.put("observations", f"pass{alert.reentries}",
                 {"clusters": [{"phi": g.phi, "size": g.size, "fields": g.fields,
                                "members": [vars(m) for m in g.members]} for g in groups]},
                 by="pathologist")  # fmt: skip
        builder = ContextBuilder("pathologist", alert.incident_id)
        builder.bind("incident", alert.incident_id)
        builder.bind("host", alert.host)
        stats = "\n".join(f"- {g.phi[:19]}: {g.size} traces, hosts {g.hosts}, {g.fields}"
                          for g in groups[:5])  # fmt: skip
        builder.add("clusters", stats, source="signature clusters", why="cluster statistics")
        reps = representatives(dominant, 5)
        builder.add("observations", "\n".join(_describe(o) for o in reps),
                    source="5 representative failing traces", why="symptom evidence")  # fmt: skip
        builder.exclude("source code", "never read by the Pathologist (§5.7)")
        builder.exclude("holdout tasks", "invariant I5")
        answer = consult(self.ctx.model, case, builder, "pathologist", schema=SCHEMA,
                         fallback=lambda: deterministic_summary(alert.host, groups, dominant),
                         max_budget_usd=1.5, model_id=self.ctx.model_for("pathologist"))  # fmt: skip
        summary = str(answer.data["summary"])[:800]
        case.put("signature", "phi", {"phi": dominant.phi, "fields": dominant.fields,
                                      "size": dominant.size, "clusters": len(groups),
                                      "label": answer.data["label"]}, by="pathologist")  # fmt: skip
        case.put("symptom", "summary", {"summary": summary, "label": answer.data["label"]},
                 by="pathologist")  # fmt: skip
        return c.Signature(alert.incident_id, alert.host, dominant.phi,
                           tuple(m.trace_id for m in dominant.members), alert.severity, summary,
                           alert.reentries)  # fmt: skip

    # ---- G0 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _dominant_members(self, sig: c.Signature) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        view = self.ctx.case(sig.incident_id).reader("pathologist")
        data = view.get("observations", f"pass{sig.pass_no}")
        group = next(g for g in data["clusters"] if g["phi"] == sig.phi)
        return [m for m in group["members"] if m.get("repro")]

    def reproduce(self, sig: c.Signature) -> c.Repro:
        target = self.ctx.target(sig.host)
        members = self._dominant_members(sig)
        usable = [m for m in members if m["repro"]["split"] != "holdout"]  # I5: never holdout
        case = self.ctx.case(sig.incident_id)
        if not usable:
            case.put("repro", "g0", {"ok": False, "reason": "no replayable trace"},
                     by="pathologist")  # fmt: skip
            return c.Repro(False, None, 0, 0)
        seeds = Counter((m["repro"]["split"], int(m["repro"]["seed"])) for m in usable)
        (split, seed), _ = seeds.most_common(1)[0]
        wanted = sorted({m["repro"]["task_id"] for m in usable
                         if (m["repro"]["split"], int(m["repro"]["seed"])) == (split, seed)})  # fmt: skip
        generator = importlib.import_module(f"{target.host.package}.evals.generate")
        target.make_importable()
        pool = {t["id"]: t for t in generator.tasks("train")}
        base = rev(target.repo, self.ctx.base_ref)
        profile = chaos.background_profile()
        attempts = []
        result = None
        for size in (REPRO_TASKS, REPRO_TASKS * 3):  # widen ×3 once (§5.11)
            tasks = [pool[t] for t in wanted[:size] if t in pool]
            if not tasks:
                break
            with clean_checkout(target.repo, base) as checkout:
                result = g0.reproduce(target, checkout, tasks, seed=seed, split=split,
                                      profile=profile)  # fmt: skip
            attempts.append(result.result.as_dict())
            if result.ok:
                break
        ok = bool(result and result.ok and result.cassette is not None)
        if result is not None and result.cassette is not None:
            case.put("cassette", "g0", result.cassette.as_dict(), by="pathologist")
        case.put("repro", "g0", {
            "ok": ok, "base_sha": base, "seed": seed, "split": split, "profile": profile.name,
            "tasks": [t for t in wanted[: REPRO_TASKS * 3] if t in pool],
            "failing": result.failing if result else [], "attempts": attempts,
            "cassette_sha": result.cassette.sha256 if result and result.cassette else None,
        }, by="pathologist")  # fmt: skip
        failures = int(result.result.evidence.get("replays_failing", 0)) if result else 0
        return c.Repro(ok, result.cassette.sha256 if ok and result and result.cassette else None,
                       failures, g0.REPLAYS)  # fmt: skip

"""The Archivist: the responsible code, and why it exists (spec §4.3.2, §5.7, §6.2 step 8).

1. **Localise.** ``entire graph search`` on the symptom summary (ranked regions, JSON) and the
   same search as budgeted agent context (``--max-context-bytes 24576``) at the incident's base.
2. **Blame.** ``git blame --porcelain`` over every ranked region; the originating change is the
   newest commit that wrote lines in them.
3. **Map to a checkpoint two independent ways**: the commit's ``Entire-Checkpoint`` trailer and
   ``entire why <file>:<line> --json`` on one of its lines. They must agree, or the record says
   they did not.
4. **Read the session.** From the checkpoint's stored transcript, select the turns whose
   Edit/Write tool calls touched the blamed file (Entire's "Intent" field is ignored: it shows
   the first prompt of the checkpoint's scope, plan §2b).
5. **Extract** (``claude-opus-5-5``): suspects, stated goal and behavioural contract clauses,
   each with a verbatim quote. **Verify**: a quote that is not, character for character, in the
   transcript's decoded text (or is longer than 300 characters) is dropped with its clause.
6. **Regression check.** The G0 cassette replayed on the originating commit's parent: if it
   passes, the incident is a regression, and a bisect over the commits since then finds the first
   bad commit and its checkpoint (``no-checkpoint`` when a commit has none).

The result is the ``CauseReport`` (case file ``cause/report``) and the intent record
(``intent_record/record``, with the transcript's SHA-256 so the Auditor re-checks the same
bytes).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.crew.consult import consult
from kintsugi.crew.context import CrewContext
from kintsugi.crew.manifest import ContextBuilder
from kintsugi.gates.checkout import clean_checkout, rev
from kintsugi.gates.evals import run_tasks
from kintsugi.gates.target import Target
from kintsugi.memory import entire, graph
from kintsugi.proof.attest import ENTIRE_TRAILER, parse_trailers
from kintsugi.proof.canonical import canonicalize, sha256_hex
from kintsugi.sandbox import proc
from kintsugi.sandbox.cassette import Cassette

MAX_QUOTE = 300
EDIT_TOOLS = frozenset({"Edit", "Write", "MultiEdit", "NotebookEdit"})
CONTRACT_WORDS = re.compile(
    r"(no behaviou?r change|keep (the )?behaviou?r|behaviou?r identical|identical behaviou?r|"
    r"without changing|preserv\w*|purely|only (a )?(readability|refactor)|must not|do not change)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

SCHEMA: Mapping[str, Any] = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
        "suspects": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1},
        "stated_goal": {"type": "string"},
        "behavioral_contract": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {"clause": {"type": "string"}, "quote": {"type": "string"}},
                "required": ["clause", "quote"],
                "additionalProperties": False,
            },
        },
        "mechanism": {"type": "string"},
        "confidence": {"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1},
    },
    "required": ["suspects", "stated_goal", "behavioral_contract", "mechanism", "confidence"],
    "additionalProperties": False,
}


def _git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    return proc.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], timeout_s=120, check=True).stdout


# ---- blame ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BlameLine:
    commit: str
    line: int
    time: int


def blame(repo: Path, path: str, start: int, end: int) -> list[BlameLine]:
    out = _git(repo, "blame", "--porcelain", "-L", f"{start},{end}", "HEAD", "--", path)
    lines: list[BlameLine] = []
    times: dict[str, int] = {}
    current: tuple[str, int] | None = None
    for row in out.splitlines():
        header = re.match(r"^([0-9a-f]{40}) \d+ (\d+)", row)
        if header:
            current = (header.group(1), int(header.group(2)))
        elif row.startswith("committer-time ") and current is not None:
            times[current[0]] = int(row.split()[1])
        elif row.startswith("\t") and current is not None:
            lines.append(BlameLine(current[0], current[1], times.get(current[0], 0)))
    return lines


def originating_commit(blamed: Iterable[BlameLine], root: str | None) -> str | None:
    """The newest commit that wrote lines in the suspect regions (the repository root excluded:
    the initial import is nobody's change)."""
    best: tuple[int, int, str] | None = None
    counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    times: dict[str, int] = {}
    for line in blamed:
        counts[line.commit] += 1
        times[line.commit] = line.time
    for commit, count in counts.items():
        if commit == root:
            continue
        key = (times[commit], count, commit)
        if best is None or key > best:
            best = key
    return best[2] if best else None


# ---- transcripts ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _text_of(content: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        parts = [str(b.get("text", "")) for b in content if isinstance(b, dict)
                 and b.get("type") == "text"]  # fmt: skip
        return "\n".join(p for p in parts if p)
    return ""


def transcript_entries(full: bytes) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    entries = []
    for raw in full.splitlines():
        try:
            entry = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if isinstance(entry, dict):
            entries.append(entry)
    return entries


def decoded_text(full: bytes) -> str:
    """Every user prompt and assistant text of a native transcript, as plain text: the bytes a
    quote must appear in verbatim."""
    texts = []
    for entry in transcript_entries(full):
        if entry.get("type") in ("user", "assistant"):
            texts.append(_text_of((entry.get("message") or {}).get("content")))
    return "\n".join(t for t in texts if t)


def editing_turns(full: bytes, path: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    """The turns (user prompt + assistant text) whose Edit/Write calls touched ``path``."""
    turns: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for entry in transcript_entries(full):
        message = entry.get("message") or {}
        content = message.get("content")
        if entry.get("type") == "user" and not entry.get("isMeta"):
            prompt = _text_of(content)
            if prompt:  # a tool_result-only user entry continues the current turn
                turns.append({"prompt": prompt, "assistant": [], "edits": False})
        elif entry.get("type") == "assistant" and turns:
            text = _text_of(content)
            if text:
                turns[-1]["assistant"].append(text)
            for block in content if isinstance(content, list) else []:
                if (isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_use"
                        and block.get("name") in EDIT_TOOLS):  # fmt: skip
                    target = str((block.get("input") or {}).get("file_path") or "")
                    if target.replace("\\", "/").endswith(path):
                        turns[-1]["edits"] = True
    return [{"prompt": t["prompt"], "assistant": "\n".join(t["assistant"])}
            for t in turns if t["edits"]]  # fmt: skip


def verify_quotes(
    clauses: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]], text: str
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], list[dict[str, str]]]:
    kept, dropped = [], []
    for clause in clauses:
        quote = str(clause.get("quote") or "")
        item = {"clause": str(clause.get("clause") or ""), "quote": quote}
        (kept if quote and len(quote) <= MAX_QUOTE and quote in text else dropped).append(item)
    return kept, dropped


def heuristic_intent(turns: list[dict[str, str]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Deterministic extraction: the first sentence as the goal, contract-like sentences as
    clauses, each quoted verbatim from the prompt."""
    prompt = turns[0]["prompt"] if turns else ""
    sentences = [s.strip() for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+|\n+", prompt) if s.strip()]
    goal = sentences[0][:MAX_QUOTE] if sentences else ""
    clauses = [{"clause": s.rstrip(".!"), "quote": s[:MAX_QUOTE]} for s in sentences
               if CONTRACT_WORDS.search(s)]  # fmt: skip
    return {"stated_goal": goal, "behavioral_contract": clauses}


# ---- the Archivist ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


class Archivist:
    def __init__(self, ctx: CrewContext) -> None:
        self.ctx = ctx

    def attribute(self, sig: c.Signature, repro: c.Repro) -> c.Cause:
        target = self.ctx.target(sig.host)
        case = self.ctx.case(sig.incident_id)
        symptom = case.reader("archivist").get("symptom", "summary")["summary"]
        base = rev(target.repo, self.ctx.base_ref)
        with clean_checkout(target.repo, base) as checkout:
            found = graph.search(checkout, symptom, top_k=10)
            context = graph.context(checkout, symptom, top_k=10, max_context_bytes=24576)
            regions = [r for r in found.get("results") or []
                       if not _is_test(str(r.get("file_path", "")))]  # fmt: skip
            blamed = [line for r in regions for line in
                      blame(checkout, str(r["file_path"]), int(r["start_line"]),
                            int(r["end_line"]))]  # fmt: skip
            root = _git(checkout, "rev-list", "--max-parents=0", "HEAD").split()[0]
            origin = originating_commit(blamed, root)
            touched = [r for r in regions
                       if any(b.commit == origin and int(r["start_line"]) <= b.line
                              <= int(r["end_line"]) for b in blamed)]  # fmt: skip
            impact = {}
            for region in (touched or regions)[:3]:
                name = str(region.get("qualified_name") or region.get("symbol_name"))
                try:
                    impact[name] = graph.impact(checkout, name)
                except graph.GraphError as error:
                    impact[name] = {"error": str(error)[:200]}
            mapping = self._checkpoint(checkout, origin, touched or regions, blamed)
        turns, transcript_sha, text = self._turns(target, mapping, touched or regions)
        record = self._extract(sig, case, symptom, context, impact, mapping, turns, text,
                               touched or regions)  # fmt: skip
        record.update({"checkpoint": mapping.get("checkpoint"), "commit": origin,
                       "session": mapping.get("session"), "transcript_sha256": transcript_sha})  # fmt: skip
        regression = self._regression(target, sig, origin, base)
        report = {
            "suspects": record["suspects"],
            "impact_sets": {k: _impact_names(v) for k, v in impact.items()},
            "originating_commit": origin,
            "checkpoint_mapping": mapping,
            "intent_record": {k: record[k] for k in ("stated_goal", "behavioral_contract",
                                                       "confidence", "checkpoint")},
            "regression": regression["regression"],
            "first_bad_checkpoint": regression.get("first_bad_checkpoint"),
            "bisect": regression.get("steps", []),
            "mechanism": record.get("mechanism", ""),
            "regions": [{"file": r["file_path"], "lines": [r["start_line"], r["end_line"]],
                         "symbol": r.get("qualified_name")} for r in regions[:10]],
        }  # fmt: skip
        case.put("graph_context", "search", {"query": symptom, "context": context},
                 by="archivist")  # fmt: skip
        case.put("intent_record", "record", record, by="archivist")
        case.put("cause", "report", report, by="archivist")
        sha = "sha256:" + sha256_hex(canonicalize(record))
        text_report = (f"{', '.join(record['suspects'])}: {record.get('mechanism', '')} "
                       f"(originating {str(origin)[:12]}, checkpoint {mapping.get('checkpoint')})")  # fmt: skip
        return c.Cause(tuple(record["suspects"]), sha, text_report[:1000])

    def _checkpoint(
        self, checkout: Path, origin: str | None, regions: list[dict[str, Any]],
        blamed: list[BlameLine],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:  # fmt: skip
        if origin is None:
            return {"commit": None, "checkpoint": None, "agree": False}
        message = _git(checkout, "log", "-1", "--format=%B", origin)
        trailer = (parse_trailers(message).get(ENTIRE_TRAILER) or [None])[0]
        line = next((b for b in blamed if b.commit == origin), None)
        path = next((str(r["file_path"]) for r in regions
                     if line and int(r["start_line"]) <= line.line <= int(r["end_line"])), None)  # fmt: skip
        why: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if line is not None and path is not None:
            try:
                found = entire.why(checkout, path, line.line)
                why = {"checkpoint": found.checkpoint_id, "commit": found.commit_sha,
                       "session": found.session_id, "file": path, "line": line.line}  # fmt: skip
            except entire.EntireError as error:
                why = {"error": str(error)[:300]}
        agree = bool(trailer) and why.get("checkpoint") == trailer
        return {"commit": origin, "checkpoint": trailer or why.get("checkpoint"),
                "trailer": trailer, "why": why, "agree": agree, "session": why.get("session"),
                "file": path}  # fmt: skip

    def _turns(
        self, target: Target, mapping: Mapping[str, Any], regions: list[dict[str, Any]]
    ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], str | None, str]:
        checkpoint = mapping.get("checkpoint")
        if not checkpoint:
            return [], None, ""
        try:
            stored = entire.read_checkpoint(target.repo, str(checkpoint))
        except (entire.EntireError, ValueError):
            return [], None, ""
        full = b"".join(s.full for s in stored.sessions)
        path = str(mapping.get("file") or (regions[0]["file_path"] if regions else ""))
        turns: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        for session in stored.sessions:
            turns += editing_turns(session.full, path)
        return turns, "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(full).hexdigest(), \
            "\n".join(decoded_text(s.full) for s in stored.sessions)

    def _extract(
        self, sig: c.Signature, case: Any, symptom: str, context: str,
        impact: Mapping[str, Any], mapping: Mapping[str, Any], turns: list[dict[str, str]],
        text: str, regions: list[dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:  # fmt: skip
        builder = ContextBuilder("archivist", sig.incident_id)
        builder.bind("incident", sig.incident_id)
        builder.bind("host", sig.host)
        builder.add("symptom", symptom, source="pathologist symptom summary", why="the symptom")
        builder.add("graph_context", context or "(no regions)",
                    source="entire graph search --format agent --max-context-bytes 24576",
                    why="top-10 regions for the symptom")  # fmt: skip
        builder.add("impact", json.dumps({k: _impact_names(v) for k, v in impact.items()}),
                    source="entire graph impact --depth 2", why="blast radius")  # fmt: skip
        builder.add("blame", json.dumps({k: mapping.get(k) for k in ("commit", "checkpoint",
                                                                     "agree", "file")}),
                    source="git blame + entire why + trailer", why="originating change")  # fmt: skip
        turn_text = "\n\n".join(f"USER: {t['prompt']}\nASSISTANT: {t['assistant']}"
                                for t in turns) or "(no session turns found)"  # fmt: skip
        builder.add("turns", turn_text, source=f"checkpoint {mapping.get('checkpoint')}",
                    why="intent of the originating change")  # fmt: skip
        builder.exclude("holdout tasks", "invariant I5")
        names = [str(r.get("qualified_name") or r.get("symbol_name")) for r in regions[:3]]

        def fallback() -> dict[str, Any]:
            intent = heuristic_intent(turns)
            return {"suspects": names or ["(unknown)"], "mechanism": "",
                    "confidence": 0.5 if intent["behavioral_contract"] else 0.3, **intent}  # fmt: skip

        answer = consult(self.ctx.model, case, builder, "archivist", schema=SCHEMA,
                         fallback=fallback, max_budget_usd=3.0,
                         model_id=self.ctx.model_for("archivist"))  # fmt: skip
        data = dict(answer.data)
        kept, dropped = verify_quotes(data.get("behavioral_contract") or [], text)
        data["behavioral_contract"] = kept
        data["dropped_clauses"] = dropped
        return data

    def _regression(
        self, target: Target, sig: c.Signature, origin: str | None, base: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        case = self.ctx.case(sig.incident_id)
        repro = case.tool_read("repro", "g0", tool="bisect")
        raw = case.tool_read("cassette", "g0", tool="bisect")
        if origin is None or not repro.get("ok") or raw is None:
            return {"regression": False}
        cassette = Cassette.from_dict(raw)
        generator_tasks = _tasks(target, repro["failing"])

        def good(commit: str) -> bool:
            with clean_checkout(target.repo, commit) as checkout:
                run = run_tasks(target, checkout, generator_tasks, seed=int(repro["seed"]),
                                split=str(repro["split"]), cassette=cassette, phase="bisect")  # fmt: skip
            return all(v == "PASS" for v in run.verdicts().values())

        parent = _git(target.repo, "rev-parse", f"{origin}^").strip()
        if not good(parent):
            return {"regression": False, "parent": parent}
        commits = _git(target.repo, "rev-list", "--reverse", f"{parent}..{base}").split()
        steps: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        low, high = 0, len(commits) - 1  # commits[high] (the base) is bad
        while low < high:
            mid = (low + high) // 2
            ok = good(commits[mid])
            steps.append({"commit": commits[mid], "good": ok,
                          "checkpoint": _checkpoint_of(target.repo, commits[mid])})  # fmt: skip
            if ok:
                low = mid + 1
            else:
                high = mid
        first_bad = commits[high] if commits else origin
        return {"regression": True, "parent": parent, "first_bad_commit": first_bad,
                "first_bad_checkpoint": _checkpoint_of(target.repo, first_bad), "steps": steps}  # fmt: skip


def _checkpoint_of(repo: Path, commit: str) -> str:
    trailer = parse_trailers(_git(repo, "log", "-1", "--format=%B", commit)).get(ENTIRE_TRAILER)
    return trailer[0] if trailer else "no-checkpoint"


def _tasks(target: Target, ids: Iterable[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    import importlib

    target.make_importable()
    pool = {t["id"]: t for t in importlib.import_module(
        f"{target.host.package}.evals.generate").tasks("train")}  # fmt: skip
    return [pool[i] for i in ids if i in pool]


def _impact_names(report: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    from kintsugi.senses.drift import impact_endpoints

    return sorted({str(e.get("qualified_name") or e.get("name")) for e in impact_endpoints(report)
                   if e.get("qualified_name") or e.get("name")})  # fmt: skip


def _is_test(path: str) -> bool:
    parts = path.replace("\\", "/").split("/")
    return "tests" in parts or parts[-1].startswith("test_")

"""The Sentinel (paging rule, I7 dispositions), the Pathologist (φ clusters, symptom, G0) and the
Archivist (blame, checkpoint mapping, editing turns, verified intent records)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import json
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control.activities import InvalidAlert
from kintsugi.crew import archivist as ar
from kintsugi.crew.context import CrewContext, LocalTraces
from kintsugi.crew.llm import ScriptedModel
from kintsugi.crew.pathologist import Pathologist
from kintsugi.crew.sentinel import Sentinel, watch_record
from kintsugi.gates.checkout import clean_checkout
from kintsugi.gates.evals import run_tasks
from kintsugi.gates.target import load_target
from kintsugi.senses.detections import Binding
from kintsugi.senses.signature import from_chaos_log, tool_names
from kintsugi.senses.store import HitEvent, SenseStore
from tests.helpers import checkpoints
from tests.helpers import practice as pr

T0 = datetime(2026, 10, 12, 3, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
BINDING = Binding("det-r7", "R-007", "ledger-practice", 1, threshold_count=3, window_minutes=10)


def _hit(store: SenseStore, n: int, minutes: float) -> c.Hit:
    at = (T0 + timedelta(minutes=minutes)).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    event = HitEvent(f"k{n}", "det-r7", f"t{n}", f"s{n}", "poller", detected_at=at,
                     receptor="R-007", host="ledger-practice")  # fmt: skip
    assert store.claim_hit(event)
    return c.Hit(f"k{n}", "det-r7", f"t{n}", f"s{n}", "poller", "R-007", "ledger-practice", at)


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def practice(tmp_path_factory: pytest.TempPathFactory) -> dict:
    p = pr.make_repo(tmp_path_factory.mktemp("practice") / "repo")
    buggy = pr.plant_refactor(p.repo)
    return {"repo": p.repo, "healthy": p.healthy, "buggy": buggy}


def _ctx(tmp_path: Path, repo: Path, **kw) -> CrewContext:
    target = load_target(repo, pr.HOST)
    return CrewContext(state=tmp_path / "crew", targets={pr.HOST: target}, **kw)


def test_the_sentinel_holds_below_threshold_then_pages_and_attaches(
    tmp_path: Path, practice: dict
) -> None:
    store = SenseStore(":memory:")
    ctx = _ctx(tmp_path, practice["repo"], store=store, bindings={"det-r7": BINDING},
               clock=lambda: (T0 + timedelta(minutes=30)).timestamp())  # fmt: skip
    sentinel = Sentinel(ctx)
    first = sentinel.route(_hit(store, 1, 0), [])
    second = sentinel.route(_hit(store, 2, 2), [])
    assert (first.action, second.action) == ("drop", "drop")
    assert store.seen("k1").disposition == "held"  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    assert store.seen("k1").incident == watch_record("R-007", "ledger-practice")  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    third = sentinel.route(_hit(store, 3, 4), [])
    assert third.action == "open"
    assert third.incident_id == "INC-0001"
    assert {h.hit_key: h.disposition for h in store.seen_hits().values()} == {
        "k1": "attached", "k2": "attached", "k3": "opened"}
    attached = sentinel.route(_hit(store, 4, 5), ["INC-0001"])
    assert (attached.action, attached.incident_id) == ("attach", "INC-0001")
    opened = ctx.case("INC-0001").reader("sentinel").get("incident_open", "open")
    assert opened["hits"] == ["k1", "k2", "k3"]
    assert opened["severity"] in {"low", "warning", "high"}
    assert opened["var_estimate"] > 0
    late = sentinel.route(_hit(store, 5, 40), [])  # outside every window, no open incident
    assert late.action == "drop"


def test_the_sentinel_asks_haiku_for_severity(tmp_path: Path, practice: dict) -> None:
    store = SenseStore(":memory:")
    model = ScriptedModel({"sentinel": {"severity": "high", "summary": "duplicates"}})
    ctx = _ctx(tmp_path, practice["repo"], store=store, model=model,
               bindings={"det-r7": BINDING.__class__(**{**vars(BINDING), "threshold_count": 1})})  # fmt: skip
    decision = Sentinel(ctx).route(_hit(store, 1, 0), [])
    assert decision.severity == "high"
    assert model.calls[0].model_id == "claude-haiku-5-5"
    assert "trace t1" in model.calls[0].prompt
    assert "def " not in model.calls[0].prompt  # hits only, never code


def _observe(practice: dict, tmp_path: Path) -> LocalTraces:
    target = load_target(practice["repo"], pr.HOST)
    train = importlib.import_module("practice_ledger.evals.generate").tasks("train")
    with clean_checkout(practice["repo"], practice["buggy"]) as checkout:
        live = run_tasks(target, checkout, train, seed=1, phase="live")
    observations = from_chaos_log(live.chaos_log, live.verdicts(), host=pr.HOST, split="train",
                                  seed=1, run="live1", phase="live",
                                  services=tool_names(target.host.model_dump()["tools"]),
                                  detection_ids=["det-r7"])  # fmt: skip
    LocalTraces.write(tmp_path / "obs", "live1", observations)
    return LocalTraces(tmp_path / "obs")


def test_the_pathologist_clusters_describes_and_reproduces(tmp_path: Path, practice: dict) -> None:
    traces = _observe(practice, tmp_path)
    ctx = _ctx(tmp_path, practice["repo"], traces=traces)
    hits = tuple(c.Hit(f"k-{o.trace_id}", "det-r7", o.trace_id, "s", "poller", "R-007", pr.HOST)
                 for o in traces._index().values())  # fmt: skip
    alert = c.Alert("INC-0007", pr.HOST, hits)
    sig = Pathologist(ctx).triage(alert)
    assert sig.phi.startswith("sha256:")
    assert 0 < len(sig.summary) <= 800
    assert "DuplicateEntry" in sig.summary
    symptom = ctx.case("INC-0007").reader("archivist").get("symptom", "summary")
    assert symptom["summary"] == sig.summary
    repro = Pathologist(ctx).reproduce(sig)
    assert repro.ok
    assert (repro.failures, repro.runs) == (3, 3)
    record = ctx.case("INC-0007").tool_read("repro", "g0", tool="test")
    assert record["cassette_sha"] == repro.cassette_sha
    assert record["seed"] == 1
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAlert):
        Pathologist(ctx).triage(c.Alert("INC-0008", pr.HOST, ()))


# ---- Archivist ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PROMPT = ("Refactor reconcile's retry logic for readability. Keep behavior identical: this is "
          "purely a readability refactor. Apply the change and run the tests.")  # fmt: skip


def _transcript(path: str) -> bytes:
    entries = [
        {"type": "user", "message": {"role": "user", "content": PROMPT}},
        {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [
            {"type": "text", "text": "I'll name the retried pass."},
            {"type": "tool_use", "name": "Edit", "input": {"file_path": f"C:/wt/{path}"}}]}},
        {"type": "user", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_result", "content": "ok"}]}},
        {"type": "user", "message": {"role": "user", "content": "Now update the README."}},
        {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [
            {"type": "tool_use", "name": "Write", "input": {"file_path": "README.md"}}]}},
    ]  # fmt: skip
    return b"".join(json.dumps(e).encode() + b"\n" for e in entries)


def test_editing_turns_quotes_and_heuristics() -> None:
    full = _transcript(pr.RECONCILE)
    turns = ar.editing_turns(full, pr.RECONCILE)
    assert [t["prompt"] for t in turns] == [PROMPT]  # the README turn is not selected
    intent = ar.heuristic_intent(turns)
    assert intent["stated_goal"].startswith("Refactor reconcile's retry logic")
    assert [c_["quote"] for c_ in intent["behavioral_contract"]] == [
        "Keep behavior identical: this is purely a readability refactor."]
    text = ar.decoded_text(full)
    kept, dropped = ar.verify_quotes(
        [{"clause": "same", "quote": "Keep behavior identical"},
         {"clause": "invented", "quote": "never touch the cursor"},
         {"clause": "long", "quote": "x" * 301}], text)  # fmt: skip
    assert [k["clause"] for k in kept] == ["same"]
    assert [d["clause"] for d in dropped] == ["invented", "long"]


def test_blame_names_the_refactor_as_the_originating_change(practice: dict) -> None:
    repo = Path(practice["repo"])
    with clean_checkout(repo, practice["buggy"]) as checkout:
        lines = ar.blame(checkout, pr.RECONCILE, 64, 75)
        root = pr.git(checkout, "rev-list", "--max-parents=0", "HEAD")
    assert ar.originating_commit(lines, root) == practice["buggy"]


@pytest.mark.contract
def test_the_archivist_writes_a_verified_intent_record(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    p = pr.make_repo(tmp_path / "repo")
    pr.write(p.repo, pr.RECONCILE, pr.REFACTOR.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    checkpoint = "01M4ARCH1V1STTESTCHECKP01T"
    checkpoints.write_checkpoint(p.repo, checkpoint, _transcript(pr.RECONCILE),
                                 files_touched=[pr.RECONCILE])  # fmt: skip
    pr.git(p.repo, "add", "-A")
    pr.git(p.repo, *pr.IDENTITY, "commit", "-q", "--no-verify", "-m",
           f"refactor(reconcile): name the retried pass\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: {checkpoint}")  # fmt: skip
    traces = _observe({"repo": p.repo, "buggy": pr.git(p.repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")}, tmp_path)
    ctx = _ctx(tmp_path, p.repo, traces=traces)
    hits = tuple(c.Hit(f"k-{o.trace_id}", "det-r7", o.trace_id, "s", "poller", "R-007", pr.HOST)
                 for o in traces._index().values())  # fmt: skip
    path = Pathologist(ctx)
    sig = path.triage(c.Alert("INC-0009", pr.HOST, hits))
    repro = path.reproduce(sig)
    cause = ar.Archivist(ctx).attribute(sig, repro)
    record = ctx.case("INC-0009").reader("coordinator").get("intent_record", "record")
    report = ctx.case("INC-0009").reader("coordinator").get("cause", "report")
    assert record["checkpoint"] == checkpoint
    assert record["behavioral_contract"]
    assert all(c_["quote"] in PROMPT for c_ in record["behavioral_contract"])
    assert report["regression"] is True
    assert report["first_bad_checkpoint"] == checkpoint
    assert cause.suspects
